description: This is a white, circular planter with a cutout design featuring Roman numerals. The Roman numerals are integrated into the body of the planter, creating an open, airy aesthetic. The planter has a distinct rim at the top and a slightly wider base, giving it a stable and elegant silhouette. The overall design is modern and somewhat minimalist, with the cutouts serving as a primary decorative element. The absence of color and texture suggests a clean, sophisticated appearance, making it suitable for a variety of indoor or outdoor settings where a touch of classic design is desired.
